about: Conception Bay South is a town on the Avalon Peninsula of Newfoundland and Labrador, along the south shore of Conception Bay west of St. John’s. It strings together former outports—Kelligrews, Manuels, Topsail, Chamberlains, and others—into one long coastal municipality. Beaches, a boardwalk, and bay views are the public face of the place. About 27,000 people live in Conception Bay South.
